items.stem: Which capstone fact can be treated as an actual customer's measured result?

options.text: Any AI-generated replacement value.
Every number in the scenario is a verified Glean customer result.
Any peer result found online.
None; scenario inputs are fictional training data with specified evidence labels.

items.stem: What makes the capstone Visioning output defensible?

options.text: Outcome-led priorities with evidence/rationale, uncertainty, owners and an explicit simulated decision.
The highest slide count.
A list of agent names chosen before discovery.
A claim that every idea is a quick win.

items.stem: How many prioritized workflows must be mapped in the proposed capstone?

options.text: Only one generic diagram with no actor or data.
Two current/future workflow pairs with assumptions and controls.
Zero; the ROI headline is enough.
Every imaginable department in the company.

items.stem: Which capstone value model should pass review?

options.text: A peer result labeled as this customer's actual.
Traceable units and assumptions, ranges, costs, evidence labels and double-count controls.
An optimistic number with no formula.
A model that deletes negative scenarios.

items.stem: The simulated sponsor asks for a pilot. What should the learner do?

options.text: Say a pilot is impossible under all circumstances.
Promise deployment immediately.
Treat the role-play request as real approval.
Clarify the decision, evaluate lighter options and state readiness/approval requirements if a pilot is needed.

items.stem: A capstone scores 86 but has a critical unsafe-data gate failure. What is the proposed outcome?

options.text: Automatic pass because the total exceeds 80.
Ignore all critical gates if presentation is strong.
Issue a certificate and conceal the failure.
Not passed until the critical issue is remediated and reassessed.

items.stem: Can an AI reviewer alone issue the proposed credential?

options.text: No; a qualified human assessor and approved program governance are required.
Yes; any confident narrative equals certification.
Yes; a ZIP checksum proves proficiency.
Yes; SCORM completion replaces the practical rubric.

items.stem: What belongs in the final submission manifest?

options.text: Only an unlinked video file.
Only a course attendance screenshot.
Only the learner's preferred certificate title.
Artifact IDs, versions, evidence paths, assumption/source references and review/remediation record.
